en.title: Reverse Text — Coding.Tools
en.description: Reverse any text string instantly. Free online text reversal tool.
en.toolDescription: Reverse text character by character, useful for obfuscation, testing, and fun.
en.inputPlaceholder: Enter or paste text to reverse...
descParas: This tool reverses any text string character by character. It is useful for obfuscation, testing string handling in applications, creating mirror text, or simply having fun with words and sentences.
The reversal runs locally in your browser. The text you paste into the editor is not uploaded, stored, or sent to a server, so you can use the tool privately and instantly.
steps: Paste or type your text into the input editor.
Click Reverse Text to reverse the entire string character by character.
The reversed text replaces the input in the editor. Use Copy for the clipboard, Download for a text file, or Clear to reset the editor.
whatIsParas: Text reversal is the process of rearranging the characters in a string so that the last character becomes the first, the second-to-last becomes the second, and so on. For example, "hello" becomes "olleh". This is sometimes called a string reverse or mirror text operation.
en.inputNotesPara: The tool works with any text, including Unicode characters, emojis, and multi-line content. Each line is preserved in the output; only the order of characters within the full text is reversed.
en.examplePara: See how text looks before and after reversal:
en.exampleCode:
--- Original Text ---
Hello, World!

--- Reversed Text ---
!dlroW ,olleH

--- Another Example ---
Coding.Tools

--- Reversed ---
slooT.gnidoC

cn.title: 文本反转 — Coding.Tools
cn.description: 即时反转任何文本字符串。免费在线文本反转工具。
cn.toolDescription: 逐字符反转文本，可用于混淆、测试和娱乐。
cn.inputPlaceholder: 输入或粘贴要反转的文本...
descParas: 此工具逐字符反转任何文本字符串。它可用于混淆、测试应用程序中的字符串处理、创建镜像文本，或简单地玩文字游戏。
反转在浏览器中本地运行。您粘贴到编辑器中的文本不会被上传、存储或发送到服务器。
steps: 在输入编辑器中粘贴或输入文本。
点击文本反转逐字符反转整个字符串。
反转后的文本替换编辑器中的输入。使用复制复制到剪贴板，下载保存为文本文件，或清除重置编辑器。
whatIsParas: 文本反转是重新排列字符串中字符的过程，使最后一个字符成为第一个，倒数第二个成为第二个，依此类推。例如，"hello" 变成 "olleh"。这有时被称为字符串反转或镜像文本操作。
cn.inputNotesPara: 该工具适用于任何文本，包括 Unicode 字符、表情符号和多行内容。输出中保留每行；只有整个文本中字符的顺序被反转。
cn.examplePara: 查看文本反转前后的效果：
cn.exampleCode:
--- Original Text ---
Hello, World!

--- Reversed Text ---
!dlroW ,olleH

--- Another Example ---
Coding.Tools

--- Reversed ---
slooT.gnidoC
